technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Integrated production

# Included processes
The inventory describes the production of grass seed on the field. Included are sowing, fertilisation, plant protection and the harvest as well as direct field emissions and land use. The transports of the inputs to the farm are included. The system boundary is at the farm gate.
